an10.3:1.1: Dussīlassa bhikkhave sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.3:1.2: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti pāmujjaṃ,
an10.3:1.3: pāmujje asati pāmujjavipannassa hatupanisā hoti pīti,
an10.3:1.4: pītiyā asati pītivipannassa hatupanisā hoti passaddhi,
an10.3:1.5: passaddhiyā asati passaddhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti sukhaṃ,
an10.3:1.6: sukhe asati sukhavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi,
an10.3:1.7: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an10.3:1.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an10.3:1.9: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an10.3:1.10: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno, tassa papaṭikā pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an10.3:1.11: evam eva kho bhikkhave dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.3:1.12: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an10.3:2.1: Sīlavato bhikkhave sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.3:2.2: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti pāmujjaṃ,
an10.3:2.3: pāmujje sati pāmujjasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti pīti,
an10.3:2.4: pītiyā sati pītisampannassa upanisasampannā hoti passaddhi,
an10.3:2.5: passaddhiyā sati passaddhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sukhaṃ,
an10.3:2.6: sukhe sati sukhasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi,
an10.3:2.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an10.3:2.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an10.3:2.9: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an10.3:2.10: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno, tassa papaṭikā pi pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an10.3:2.11: evam eva kho bhikkhave sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.3:2.12: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
